title: Maris Wavedeep
body:
![https://www.dndbeyond.com/avatars/54575/480/1581111423-159871601.jpeg|medium|right](https://www.dndbeyond.com/avatars/54575/480/1581111423-159871601.jpeg)

- Thinks she's a cleric, but actually is a warlock with an aboleth patron. The aboleth's goal is to manipulate innocents into worshiping it as a god by using its telepathy from hiding (although its actual end goal is unknown). She's from the Northern Sea, with some connection to the Aboleth Temple in that region.
- She's tied to Tidecrown by a divine mission to be an ambassador/prophet to share the good news. Belief has changed her for the better. She has a friend (another prophet named Nautia) who she arrived with - two by two!
- Stops by Lotor's food stall every morning, and tells him about the good news. He listens closely and just says "maybe next time".
- **Personality Traits:** Bubbly, friendly, enthusiastic, naïve, stubborn
- **Ideals**
	- All people deserve to know the love and joy that comes through worship, and I will bring my god the praise he deserves.
	- All must come to faith willingly. Deceit and/or manipulation are always unethical, even in non-religious circumstances.
	- There is always goodness in the world. Most people are kind-hearted and all should be given the benefit of the doubt.
- **Bonds**
	- Maris has traveled to Tidecrown with her best friend and fellow missionary.
	- She cares for her parents and four older sisters deeply.
	- Maris, also, has a strong love and respect for everyone from her home city.
- **Flaws**
	- Maris has low wisdom in general, finding herself unfortunately susceptible to everything from very casual deceit to full-on mind control. 
	- She is dense and stubborn in her faith, even in the face of proof otherwise.
	- Maris is spoiled. She is naïve and knows a very comfortable life.

### Motivation and Goals

 - [x]  Build a small temple to Adeus on Tidecrown - by using a tithe of 10% of all gold collected. ✅ 2026-04-06
 - [x]  Convert someone to her faith. ✅ 2026-04-13
 - [ ]  Bring others on a pilgrimage to her home in the Northern Sea.
 - [ ]  Complete a task from her patron (TODO: come up with what this might be)
 - [ ]  

### Development

- Fully paid off her booth fee for the Temple.
